A LITTLE HISTORY

The recipe, and the story behind it.

This collection is based on the 1930 Cook Book compiled by the Mayflower Guild of First Congregational Church in Kalamazoo, Michigan. Its 708 recipes have been carefully edited from the historical source for clear, practical use.

The original book remains the historical record. This site is a published edition of the corrected Version 8 cookbook, preserving source identifiers, contributors, and page references wherever available.
